name: Linux on mlogv32
author: Iliary
description:
This schematic contains a fully functional 32-bit RISC-V emulator that runs Linux.

In this configuration, it has 16 MiB of ROM, 14 MiB of RAM, a 70x38 character text-only display, a keyboard (sortKB), and four 16550A UART ports (though only one is currently accessible from Linux).

To use, simply build the schematic, wait a few seconds to let all of the processors initialize, then turn on the switch labeled POWER_SWITCH. Log in with the username root. Set your FPS limit to 60 for best results.

On my machine, it takes about 8 minutes from power on to the login prompt, and the game runs at ~10 FPS when the CPU is not idle. The filesystem is read-only (stored in ROM via cramfs), so /tmp is the only place where you can create files. Also, the display doesn't support escape codes, so backspace and color codes will look weird.

Requires b149.
